text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: CI + deploy jobs failing to pull packages from GitHub Packages / npm. Multiple GH Actions runners returning 503 or 401 for package downloads. Paging @oncall. Thread started 1968509999

sara: oncall here, seeing alerts. Which pipelines are blocked?

mike: release/hotfix-1.2.3 and build/hotfix artifacts. All hotfix builds are failing at the `restore-cache` / `npm install` step.

jamie: logs from a failing runner:```
GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/org/package/-/package-1.0.0.tgz 503 Service Unavailable
npm ERR! code E403
npm ERR! 401 Unauthorized - GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/org/package
```

natalie: same pattern in python wheels: `pip install` from GitHub Packages returning 503 intermittently. Deploy bot shows queued releases. :thinking_face:

mike: impact: hotfix deploys are blocked until we get package downloads working. Customers with urgent fixes are affected. ETA unknown.

sara: immediate mitigation options: 1) manual artifact build on a machine that already has caches; 2) switch GH Actions to use an alternative registry mirror (registry.npmjs.org) where possible; 3) push prebuilt tarballs to S3 and update deploy to pull from S3 as an emergency. Thoughts?

jamie: trying to re-run a job with `--prefer-offline` and `npm ci --offline` but runner hasn't cached. Rebuild on a local VM succeeded; I can upload artifact.

mike: I'm going to open a support ticket with GitHub and paste status link. @support-github please escalate.

support-github: filed under GitHub case #12345678. GitHub status: https://www.githubstatus.com/incidents (reported: Packages/Actions degradation). They acknowledged increased error rates for package registry auth.

sara: good. For customer comms: mark impacted customers as "deploys delayed" and add that we're working on a workaround; ops oncall to follow up.

natalie: starting a manual build+publish to S3 for the hotfix package. Will tag files with `hotfix-1.2.3-s3` and update deploy path. ETA ~25m.

deploy-bot: :hourglass_flowing_sand: Deployment pipeline release/hotfix-1.2.3 paused at step `fetch-artifacts` (waiting for artifacts).

jamie: quick how-to for manual fallback (for other engineers):
```
# build artifact locally
make build-package
# upload to S3
aws s3 cp dist/package-1.2.3.tgz s3://redwood-temp-artifacts/hotfix-1.2.3/
# update deployment to use S3 URL env var
RELEASE_ARTIFACT_URL=https://s3.amazonaws.com/redwood-temp-artifacts/hotfix-1.2.3/package-1.2.3.tgz ./deploy.sh
```

mike: I'm starting the manual S3 deploy now for customers on the critical list. Will post progress.

sara: assign someone to triage which customers are highest priority. @natalie you on customer impact assessment?

natalie: yes, pulling list from PagerDuty incidents and support tickets. Initial list: Customer A (production error), Customer B (blocked feature release), Customer C (nonblocking). Will DM PRs for approval on emergency deploys.

support-github: updating case: GitHub says their engineering team is investigating an auth/token rotation issue that causes intermittent 401/503 for package fetches. No firm ETA yet. They recommend using fallback registries or cached artifacts.

jamie: starting uploads for three hotfix builds now. If anyone else needs urgent release, DM me and I'll prioritize.

mike: manual deploy started. Watching logs.

deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: Manual deploy for Customer A started using S3 artifact.

sara: handoff in 30m to next on-call (mike -> jamie). @mike please summarize current state for the handoff.

mike: summary: GitHub Packages auth outages causing 401/503 on package pulls; GitHub case opened; mitigation = build artifacts locally and upload to S3 as temporary registry; manual deploys in progress for highest priority customers; monitoring for GitHub fix; switching non-critical pipelines to public npm where feasible.

jamie: I'll take over. I'll keep this thread updated with uploads, deploy progress, and any change from GH status.

natalie: customer comms draft: "We’re experiencing degraded package retrieval from GitHub Actions/Packages affecting hotfix deploy timelines. We’ve applied a manual workaround for urgent customers and will update when GH restores service." Shall I send?

sara: send to the impacted customers list now.

support-github: GitHub status updated: mitigations underway; rolling fix in progress.

jamie: manual deploys completed for Customers A and B. Customer C scheduled. Marking impacted deploys as completed in the incident tracker.

mike: once GH confirms resolved, we should revert temporary S3 artifact URLs and rebuild pipelines to use canonical registries; also validate no API keys were rotated unexpectedly.

sara: agreed. Postmortem owners: jamie (triage + mitigation), natalie (customer impact), mike (actions to avoid future reliance on single registry). Please add timeline and root cause once GH provides details.

deploy-bot: incident thread archived when last_message_ts reached 1968511200 (automated).
